notes: No accepted C++ was collected, so orig.cpp is a new constructive reference: rows 0..N-2 are filled tile by tile with a column shift, a row shift below the solved part and the column shift undone, then the last row's parity is fixed with one shift of it and the rest is finished with 3-cycle commutators (about 31k moves at 100 x 100). checker.py replays the moves; checked on the samples and 300 random grids.
